verdict.rationale: Asking whether 2D is first-class is a fair question for a rendering and game-oriented library, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes three.js only as a library "for creating 3D graphics" and never mentions sprites, tilemaps, or 2D physics. The SVG/CSS3D renderer addons are a different output feature, not a 2D game workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, 2D is a first-class workflow — sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics — not a 3D afterthought
